ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Lead_Validation), NOT(ISBLANK(MobilePhone)), OR( NOT( REGEX( MobilePhone, "^\\+?[0-9\\s\\-\\.\\(\\)xX#]{6,30}$" ) ), CONTAINS(LOWER(MobilePhone), "xxxx"), CONTAINS(LOWER(MobilePhone), "0000"), CONTAINS(LOWER(MobilePhone), "1111"), CONTAINS(LOWER(MobilePhone), "9999"), CONTAINS(LOWER(MobilePhone), "unknown"), CONTAINS(LOWER(MobilePhone), "none"), CONTAINS(LOWER(MobilePhone), "n/a"), CONTAINS(LOWER(MobilePhone), "test"), REGEX(MobilePhone, "^[\\s\\-\\.\\(\\)]+$") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The mobile number entered is not valid or appears to be a placeholder. Please enter a real mobile number. International format is preferred (e.g., +1 617 555 1234 or +44 7700 900123).
